_note: A Keyman insurance policy's sums, bonus included, under other sources, in full (D-203). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.92(2)(d) "any sum received under a Keyman insurance policy, as defined in Schedule II (Note 1) including the bonus allocated on such policy, if such income is not chargeable to income-tax under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession" or under the head "Salaries"" (p.138); an employee's such sums are profits in lieu of salary (s.18(1)(c)(iii)). TY 2025-26: 1961 s.56(2)(iv), the same by reference to s.2(24)(xi) (F(No.2)A 1996 ss.3(b), 21). Every regime. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-17-other-sources-rest.md.
